200.description: Front cover fetched from the Cover Art Archive for this MusicBrainz identifier

202.description: The cover is queued or being retrieved; ask again shortly

404.description: The archive has no cover, or none was asked for

502.description: The archive could not be reached; it is asked again later

AddedAlbum.description: An album that entered the library recently, newest first.

oneOf.description: Every track names this one artist.

retired.description: Unlinks that no longer apply to the recording's current credit; they keep hiding their association.

shareable.description: An administrator can share the latest unlink, a built-in artist review, with every account.

oneOf.description: The applied shared correction made from the latest unlink; only administrators see it.

shared_hidden.description: Saved reviews of this recording that an administrator's shared correction hides for this account.

oneOf.description: The provider reads discographies but cannot page one release type at a time.

retired.description: Items whose recording no longer carries the credit the change was made for.

shareable.description: An administrator can apply this split for every account.

oneOf.description: The applied shared correction made from this change; only administrators see it.

ArtistMatchChosen.description: A chosen artist that some of the credit's tracks already use.

automatic_tracks.description: Of those, the tracks Hito matched by itself.

evidence.description: How those tracks were matched, the largest share first.

tracks.description: Tracks of the credit that currently use this artist.

ArtistMatchEvidence.description: Tracks of a credit that one kind of evidence matched to the chosen artist.

same_length_tracks.description: Tracks of the credit that match a chosen track by title and length (within three seconds).

shared_albums.description: Distinct release titles the credit shares with the chosen artist's releases.

undecided_tracks.description: Tracks of the credit that have no current artist choice and would be updated.

chosen.description: Chosen artists the credit's tracks already use, the most used first.

dismissed.description: Suggestions the account dismissed for this credit; they are not in `items`.

dismissed_items.description: The dismissed suggestions that could still apply to undecided tracks, so each can be restored.

undecided_tracks.description: Tracks of the credit with no current artist choice.

enabled.description: Whether the account's settings allow automatic matching.

last_finished_at.description: Unix seconds when the last walk finished, if one has.

last_matched.description: Recordings the last finished walk matched.

matched_so_far.description: Recordings matched so far by the walk in progress.

declined.description: Recordings with an earlier personal decision or unlinked association.

unavailable.description: Recordings whose lookup could not be completed; they are asked again by a later pass.

uncertain.description: Provider answers that name no artist, several recordings or several artists.

similar_artists.description: How many of the account's chosen artists, named as similar, contributed tracks.

ArtistReviewCandidate.description: A MusicBrainz artist the automatic walk found under a credit's name and could not exclude.

corroborated_titles.description: Distinct titles of the credit's sample that this artist's recordings list.

in_library.description: The account already has this artist among its chosen artists.

kind.description: The artist type in lower case, such as `person` or `group`.

applied.description: Undecided tracks that now use the artist.

kept.description: Tracks left as they were because of an earlier personal decision.

remaining.description: Undecided tracks the request did not reach; asking again with `next_after` continues.

restored.description: Dismissals removed; restoring something that is not dismissed removes none.

CatalogReleaseTypeFilter.description:
Restricts a discography read to one release type. `Other` covers every group that is not an
album, EP or single, including broadcasts and groups without a known type.

after.description: The `next_after` of the previous step, to continue past tracks that step examined.

CoverageEvidence.description:
How many of a credit's probed tracks the artist listed when the credit's remaining tracks
followed it.

CreditEvidence.description: What a credit-level match started from and how many of the credit's tracks supplied it.

username.description: The account name the administrator saw, so a stale or mistaken request cannot erase a different account.

artists.description: A short page of chosen artists that radio can start from.

genres.description: The busiest genres of the library, for the By genre tiles.

provider_artist_id.description: The one artist that is not right, or every candidate of the credit when absent.

oneOf.description:
Display album artist derived from the tracks when the album has none, the same value an
album read carries.

artists.description: A short page of chosen artists for the Home shelf.

automatic_artist_lookup.description:
Match library artists on MusicBrainz in the background. Applies only while enrichment is
enabled and the built-in provider is selected.

automatic_artwork.description: Fetch album artwork from the Cover Art Archive for albums that have a MusicBrainz identifier.

automatic_service_search.description: Search connected services for playable sources of saved recordings without being asked.

kept_referenced.description: Recordings whose files are gone but that an account still uses, which stay.

more.description: More removable recordings remain; run the action again.

items.description: A library credit whose tracks the automatic walk left undecided.

candidates.description: At most three, the artists the account already has first, then the best corroborated.

plays_from_services.description: A connected, enabled service of this account can resolve sources for the recording.

oneOf.description:
Display album artist derived from the tracks when the release has no album artist. It is
never stored and never replaces a stated or personal album artist.

PlayerSpeedSupport.description:
Speeds, in thousandths, that the current source can present. A source that
supports only unit speed reports `min == max == 1000`.

PluginDeclarationCheck.description: What a read-only look at a connected service found against the declaration the account accepted.

oneOf.description: The administrator's own unlink of one built-in artist review.
The administrator's latest split of one built-in artist identity group.

artist_urls.description:
Canonical https pages of every credited performer. Hosts may match a lone page to one
MusicBrainz artist; a provider that cannot name all performers omits the list.

isrc.description: ISO 3901 recording code when the provider states one. Hosts treat it as evidence, not identity.

oneOf.description: Pages one release type at a time from providers that declare the filter.

plays_from_services.description: A connected, enabled service of this account can resolve sources for the recording.

canonical_id.description: The recording that carries the card in lists.

copies.description: Every copy including the one that carries the card; empty when the recording is alone.

oneOf.description: Why Hito knows this copy is the same song; absent for the recording that carries the card.

separate.description: The recording now shows as its own card and will not be grouped with these copies again.

oneOf.description:
Display album artist derived from the tracks when the release has no album artist. It is
never stored and never replaces a stated or personal album artist.

provider_artist_id.description: The one dismissed artist to offer again, or every dismissed candidate of the credit when absent.

artist_groups.description: Chosen artists matching the search, exact names first.

retired.description: Recordings whose tags changed after the correction was shared.

chosen_artist_id.description: The account's chosen artist with exactly this provider identity, if any.

oneOf.description: Each recording returns to the library credit it was tagged with.
Each recording moves to an exact artist identity it already reviewed.

UpdateAutomaticLookups.description: Omitted choices keep their current value.
